messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: tabsetPanel not displaying output.
parts:
I must be having a braincramp as I have used tabsets before without problem

This works showing a table below a histogram
  mainPanel(
   plotOutput("histogram"),
       tableOutput("table")
  )

But this
mainPanel(
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Histogram", plotOutput("histogram")),
    tabPanel("Table", tableOutput("table"))
              
  ) 
  )

shows the histogram but is a blank page when the 'Table' tag is clicked
